title: How to build a million dollar one-person business with AI

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if AI let one person build a $1M business in a year? How?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: With tools like AutoML, no-code platforms, and AI agents, solo founders can scale fast.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But automation could displace workers, deepen inequality, and erode human value in the economy.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are focusing on niche markets, upskilling, and creating AI that augments—not replaces—human labor.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine AI helping artisans, consultants, and educators reach global audiences without middlemen.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will favor those who align AI with human potential and purpose.

video_cue: A lone entrepreneur using an AI interface to launch a product, with a dashboard showing rapid growth and global reach.
